pageProps.title: Brewerkz Riverside Point
pageProps.review: Check out this honest pub review of Brewerkz at Riverside Point, Singapore, where you can enjoy craft beer and pizza along with a fantastic view.
pageProps.content: ## Review This is a place where you can enjoy beer with a great view. Although not pictured, the pizza and beer were delicious. The chicken I ordered because I was craving it was a bit disappointing, as the sauce was too spicy and salty. As expected, Korea still has the best chicken. ## Pictures
